repositories.description: This DCLR configuration demonstrated superior VS LION-ADAM

paragraphs: This Hugging Face Space showcases the DCLR (Dynamic Consciousness-based Learning Rate) optimizer applied to a SimpleCNN model for image classification on the CIFAR-10 dataset.

The DCLR optimizer is a novel approach that dynamically adjusts the learning rate based on the model's 'consciousness' (represented by the entropy of its output activations) and the gradient norm. Unlike traditional optimizers with fixed or schedule-based learning rates, DCLR aims to adapt more intelligently to the training landscape. It's designed to promote faster convergence and potentially better generalization by moderating step sizes based on the certainty of predictions and the steepness of the loss surface.

In our analysis, the best-tuned DCLR configuration demonstrated superior test accuracy compared to Adam, Lion, DCLRAdam, and even its original untuned configuration, highlighting its potential when properly configured.

repositories.description: Research&Development

paragraphs: Welcome to the central hub for Research & Development on Weight Manifold Fusion (WWF) technology, managed by SKT AI Labs. This space is a dedicated workbench designed to explore, test, and refine advanced neural architecture interpolation techniques.

WWF is a novel method for integrating and merging multiple pre-trained neural networks into a single, cohesive architecture. By leveraging the geometric properties of a model’s weight manifold, we can perform interpolation that preserves and synthesizes the unique knowledge stored in each model, often resulting in a combined model that outperforms its individual components.

paragraphs: Generate and explore synthetic 3D brain MRI, conditioned on age — entirely in your browser.

WaveDiT learns a velocity field in the 3D Haar-wavelet domain: a forward DWT splits each 224³ volume into 8 frequency bands, a flow-matching ODE is integrated in that compact latent, and an inverse DWT reconstructs the full-resolution volume — making 3D generation tractable on a single GPU. You steer it with one condition: age (6–95).
